question: What proportional division of house width and enclosure space applies in the daṇḍaka arrangement?
premises: The house width is specified as two parts.
The enclosure space is located in front.
A further specification places the enclosure space on one side.
inference: The daṇḍaka arrangement assigns a two-part house width with the enclosure space positioned in front and on one side.
uncertainties: The exact proportional allocation of vāraḥ relative to the two parts is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: The house width is two parts; in front is the enclosure space, and then on one side as well.
